blocks.text: The leaders of the Quad grouping comprising Australia, India, Japan and the United States are set to hold a meeting in Manila on Tuesday ahead of a historic trilateral summit between U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The meeting on the sidelines of Association of Southeast Asian Nations-related leaders’ gatherings in the Philippine capital will be the first summit of the Quad, viewed as a counterweight to China’s growing influence, since September 2024, and the first under Trump’s second administration that began in January 2025.
